description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said Keeanu Benton is scheduled to return to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Benton missed practice to open the week on Wednesday.
items.title: Keeanu Benton (ankle) expected to practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: SirVocea Dennis practiced on Thursday.
items.impact: Dennis is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Steelers.
items.title: SirVocea Dennis (foot/ankle) at practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Benjamin Morrison was at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Morrison is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Steelers.
items.title: Benjamin Morrison (quad) practices Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ayden Garnes was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Garnes missed practice to start the week due to an ankle injury.
items.title: Ayden Garnes (ankle) back at practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Antoine Winfield Jr. remained absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Winfield remains likely to sit on Sunday against the Buccaneers.
items.title: Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) still not practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jalon Daniels is expected to start on Sunday against the Steelers.
items.impact: Baker Mayfield has yet to resume throwing. Daniels will remain a QB2 play for fantasy managers.
items.title: Jalon Daniels expected to start in Week 6

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said Keisean Nixon is expected to return to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Nixon is working his way back from a groin injury.
items.title: Keisean Nixon (groin) back at practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans re-signed Chris Braswell.
items.impact: Braswell will return to the Texans practice squad in a depth role.
items.title: Chris Braswell re-signs with Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans released LB Kenneth Murray Jr.
items.impact: Murray will figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Kenneth Murray Jr. released by Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Trent Brown returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Brown missed practice to start the week on Wednesday. He should be good to go for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.title: Trent Brown (knee) back at practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders have opened the 21-day practice window for LB Jordan Magee.
items.impact: Magee will have the next few weeks to be activated.
items.title: Jordan Magee (hamstring) has practice window opened

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Alec Pierce is reportedly no longer wearing a cast but is not close to a return.
items.impact: Pierce went on injured reserve with a heel injury after Week 2. He has his first chance to return in the Colts' Week 7 game against the Vikings.
items.title: Alec Pierce (heel) out of cast, not close to returning

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Sean Tucker was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Tucker missed practice to open the week on Wednesday. He remains off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Sean Tucker (quad) returns to practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Baker Mayfield did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Mayfield has yet to resume throwing. He remains week-to-week.
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) misses practice Thursday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Pat Surtain II (ankle) has been ruled out for the Broncos contest against the Seahawks on Thursday due to an ankle injury.
items.impact: Surtain will miss yet another game, but with the Bronco's having a mini bye week, hopefully he can return for Week 7. Denver will have to make it work without him.
items.title: Pat Surtain II (ankle) out for Thursday night against Seattle

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins signed QB Brady Cook.
items.impact: Cook will add depth in the quarterback room for Miami.
items.title: Brady Cook signs with Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Chargers re-signed WR/returner Luke Grimm to the practice squad.
items.impact: Grimm will return to a depth role.
items.title: Luke Grimm re-signs with Chargers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins waived Ryan Miller.

items.title: Ryan Miller waived by Dolphins
